about_text: There are many stories about how the most famous beach bar in the country, the Flora-Bama Lounge, became the iconic location it is today. Some of the stories are even true and a few others were thought up on a local bar stool. The truth is that in 1962 the State of Florida gave the State of Alabama two miles of beach front land in return for the construction of the Perdido Pass Bridge. The Tampary family (Father Ted with sons Connie and Tony) decided to build a small bar and package store on the new State Line. The Flora-Bama was originally constructed in 1964, two years after the road was completed. In the early days of the Flora-Bama, the lounge was practically the only thing in the area. As traffic began to increase along the new highway, business grew and the lounge grew to match it with new construction added piecemeal to accommodate the larger crowds. At the time it was established Escambia County, Florida, in which it is located was "wet" while across the line Baldwin County, Alabama, was "dry". The Tamparys created a camaraderie rarely found among people of all ages and walks of life. Joseph Gilchrist purchased the tiny lounge and package store on April 17, 1978, and made live music a daily staple. Joined in 1986, by partner Pat McClellan, together they created calendar events like the "Interstate Mullet Toss" and the "Frank Brown Songwriter's Festival," named after the early, imposing night watchman. In 2009, John McInnis and Cameron Price became co-owners of the Flora-Bama, along with Joe and Pat, to carry it into the next 50 years. Together these four owners have carried on the tradition of making the Country's Best Beach Bar a place where everyone feels comfortable and leaves smiling. Today the live music at the Flora-Bama consist of local favorites to Platinum selling recording artist. The events range from chili cookoffs and fishing rodeos to the Annual Mullet Toss and big beach front concerts. The best part is there is always someone and something different going on at the Flora-Bama every day and you never know who is going to be sitting next to you.
hero_text: The World Famous Beach Bar - Live Music 365 Days a Year

Features include a fantastic salad bar, over-the-top cheesy grits, and homemade key lime or chocolate chip peanut butter pies. The restaurant is sustainable-focused, being the first in Alabama to recycle oyster shells through the AL Coastal Foundation and the only local restaurant to 'oyster garden' or grow stocker oysters for reef restoration.

The Pink Pony Pub is a legendary beachfront restaurant and bar in Gulf Shores, Alabama, known for its bright pink exterior, gulf-front views, and old-school coastal charm. Originally opened in the 1950s and reborn after multiple hurricanes, the Pink Pony has become a true local landmark where visitors and locals gather for shrimp baskets, raw oysters, burgers, gumbos, and Po' Boys. With a fun, lively atmosphere, full bar, frozen daiquiris, Bushwhackers, and family-friendly dining until 9 PM, the Pink Pony Pub delivers classic beach-bar vibes right on the sand, just steps from the Gulf of Mexico.

With friendly service and quality ingredients, Crico's Pizza and Subs is a must-visit destination for both locals and tourists craving authentic and satisfying meal on the Alabama Gulf Coast.
hero_text: The Best Pizza & Subs At The Beach Since 1998!

about_text: OSO at Bear Point Harbor is a waterfront restaurant serving lunch and dinner with a full menu featuring seafood, burgers, steaks and more. Guests can enjoy amazing sunset views from the main and upstairs dining areas, outside decks, and tiki bar. The restaurant features live music every day with hottest local and touring artists entertaining guests. Dine-in and takeout available with online ordering for curbside/dockside pickup.
hero_text: Fresh Food, Live Music Every Day, Amazing Sunsets and Waterfront Dining

about_text: The Bar & Grill at Craft Farms Golf Club overlooks Cotton Creek's 18th green with huge picture windows and a veranda. Perfect for golfers relaxing after their round or casual lunch outings with friends. The chef crafts a variety of regional features and pub fare on a seasonal basis with sharable appetizers.

Crico's Pizza and Subs in Gulf Shores, AL, is a beloved local eatery renowned for its delicious pizzas and mouthwatering subs. Nestled in the heart of Gulf Shores, this cozy establishment offers a welcoming atmosphere where patrons can enjoy freshly prepared meals with friends and family. From traditional pepperoni pizzas to specialty pies loaded with gourmet toppings, Crico's caters to every pizza lover's cravings. Their subs range from classic Italian combos to hearty meatball subs.

Award winning DeSoto's Seafood Kitchen features fresh seafood, chicken, pasta, steak, home style sides, salads and sandwiches. Daily lunch specials include seafood, chicken, country fried and hamburger steak, ham with 12 great homemade sides and fresh baked rolls. Dinner menu features exquisite appetizers, seafood prepared fried, broiled, grilled, blackened, steamed, or Cajun style, plus chicken and pasta dishes and Hawaiian Ribeye steak.

Happy Pappys is a local, family-owned coffee shop founded by the Papadelias family. The business was inspired by a coffee shop the family discovered in Texas and opened in August 2019. They provide a premium third place where patrons can unwind, socialize, and recharge while enjoying high-quality coffee and delicious food. The shop survived Hurricane Sally and the COVID-19 pandemic in its first year of operation.

The Cove Bar and Grill is the hottest restaurant in Gulf Shores, delivering bold flavors, cold drinks, and live music in a fun, electric atmosphere. Located just minutes from the beach, The Cove serves up a full menu of fresh, flavorful food from casual bites to hearty meals, with something for every appetite. With indoor and outdoor dining, pool tables, TVs, and a laid-back vibe, The Cove has become a true gathering place where locals and visitors alike come for great eats, great tunes, and unforgettable moments. Live music Monday through Saturday keeps the party going with local musicians and traveling bands filling the stage.
hero_text: Hot Food, Cold Drinks, Live Music and Serious Fun!

about_text: Down South Barbecue is located between Foley and Gulf Shores, Alabama, right on the way to the Alabama Beach. We serve the best barbecue on the coast from our family-size umbrella covered tables. Now serving breakfast! Drop by and eat your lunch or supper. After a long drive to the beach, don't worry about cooking! Let Mama relax. Get a complete meal for all your family. Great food at a fair price. We cater for big orders - call ahead so we have time to properly prepare the very best Southern Barbecue for your group!
hero_text: Serving the Best Barbecue on the Coast

about_text: Established in 1975 by Gerald King and David Bodenhamer in an old bait shop on a pier in Gulf Shores, Alabama, Sea-N-Suds is one of the original family-friendly beachfront restaurants in town. The restaurant stretches over the sugar-white sand and sits just a couple of feet away from the Gulf of Mexico, offering true beachfront dining. The original building was destroyed by Hurricane Frederic in 1979 and rebuilt. The restaurant still serves the same seafood using the same recipes passed down for generations, including their famous gumbo recipe from David Bodenhamer's grandmother, Nona Sellers, which has been in the family for over 200 years.

business_name: The Tin Top Restaurant & Oyster Bar
about_text: Located in Bon Secour along the Bon Secour River, The Tin Top Restaurant & Oyster Bar has been serving exceptional Gulf seafood and premium aged steaks since 2004. Founded by Bob Hallmark with a passion for cooking and Southern hospitality, Tin Top offers the finest casual dining experience with fresh oysters, Gulf shrimp, Royal Reds, hand-cut steaks, and seasonal house favorites. The restaurant features a relaxed coastal atmosphere with indoor and patio seating, scratch-made dishes, and a thoughtful selection of beers, wines, and cocktails. Known for exceptional ingredients treated with respect and genuine Southern hospitality, Tin Top is a local favorite and coastal dining destination.
hero_text: Alabama's Best Fresh Gulf Seafood & Prime Hand-Cut Steaks

about_text: El Toro Mexican Restaurant is a Mexican dining establishment located in Gulf Shores, Alabama, offering traditional Mexican cuisine.

Milkshake Momma was founded in 2019 in Crawford, Alabama as part of Southern Roots Country Store and Cafe. The business is known for Freak Shakes and Southern-style comfort foods. Founded by Sylvia Nolan, the concept has expanded to multiple locations including Columbus, GA and Orange Beach, AL. The company emphasizes community engagement, outstanding customer service, and a family-friendly atmosphere.

Fish River Grill is a Funky Junky Redneck Joint serving Baldwin County. It is also the home of the world famous 'Swamp Soup'. Baldwin County's award winning restaurant with great seafood, signature cocktails and famous Swamp Soup.
Fresh, delicious pizza made with quality, fresh ingredients. Pizza dough and sauce made daily. Family-friendly establishment with giant pizza slices and entertainment.

Icehouse Tap Room is a local neighborhood beach bar and restaurant located on Little Lagoon in Gulf Shores, offering uninterrupted sunset views 365 days a year. Founded in 2000 in Baton Rouge, LA, it has expanded to Gulf Shores. The restaurant features a funky indoor space and beachy outdoor space with over 30 years of family-owned bar and restaurant experience. Not corporate driven, offering full menu with made-to-order items and 24 beers on tap.

The Sloop Galley and Spirits began as an idea from two local restauranteurs with over 40 years of restaurant experience. The location and timing came together in the summer of 2019. The Sloop prides itself on fresh quality foods made in house and exceptional service. One of the partners, James Gallen, from the Philadelphia area decided to incorporate original Philly cheesesteaks on the menus as they are not offered in the south. The other partner, BR Mock, decorated the establishment with authentic sailing tools, pictures, and memorabilia from his days sailing. The Sloop is a locals eatery and watering hole. We do welcome families and children but please remember that we are a sports bar with great homemade items. We do enjoy our island visitors as well! Due to our size limitation we can only handle seating of 8 or less during peak hours.

Gulf Shores ice cream shop serving premium Blue Bell ice cream with over 40 flavor options including Italian Ice, yogurt, sherbet, and reduced fat options. Offers milkshakes, smoothies, sundaes, chocolates, and doughnut sandwiches.

Great food for the whole family featuring thin crust pizza with whole milk buffalo mozzarella, traditional and boneless wings, fresh Greek salad, and garlic cheese toast. Made with fresh ingredients including house-made Greek sauce.

business_name: The Southern Grind Coffee House at the WHARF
about_text: The Southern Grind is a specialty coffee house with two locations on the Alabama Gulf Coast. Since 2012, they have offered more than coffee, including comfort food, fresh food with vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. Known for homemade desserts, pastries, muffins, cookies, brownies, and Gelato (Italian Ice Cream). Features free Wi-Fi, cool coastal vibe, retail items including home decor, jewelry and local art, and a pet-friendly outdoor patio.

At Luna's Eat & Drink, we believe great food brings people together. From fresh Gulf seafood to soulful Southern favorites, every plate is made with care and served with a smile. Come hungry, leave happy, and taste the best of Orange Beach hospitality.
Open-air waterfront restaurant and bar offering fresh seafood, tropical drinks, and stunning views of Terry Cove. Menu features fresh oysters, tuna, Nashville Hot Chicken, and beach sides.

Family owned ice cream shop in Gulf Shores offering unique homemade cones and delicious authentic Italian ice cream (Gelato). The shop features one-of-a-kind handcrafted Twister cones freshly baked daily, filled with premium Italian ice cream and quality toppings. Inside and outside seating available in a quiet area in the heart of Gulf Shores.

Cobalt The Restaurant offers waterfront fine dining in Orange Beach, Alabama, featuring the freshest Gulf seafood, hand-crafted cocktails, stone hearth pizzas, and an extensive wine list. From signature dishes like Gulf Shrimp & Grits and our famous Crab Bisque to hand-cut steaks and Sunday Brunch, every visit is an unforgettable coastal dining experience.
hero_text: Contemporary coastal cuisine at its best

about_text: Climb aboard with a small group and get ready to fly! You will be safely harnessed in before the boat gently picks up speed, lifting you smoothly into the sky. Soar up to 400 feet above the Gulf of Mexico and take in breathtaking views of sugar-white beaches, crystal-clear turquoise water, marine life, and miles of coastline in every direction. Each flight lasts 8–10 minutes and is available for single, double, or triple riders. It's peaceful, thrilling, and unforgettable. Perfect for first timers and adventure lovers alike!

business_name: Orange Beach Dolphin & Sunset Cruises Aboard Sunny Lady
about_text: The Sunny Lady runs Dolphin Cruises daily from The Wharf in Orange Beach, Alabama. Family owned and operated, this is an ideal way to enjoy a relaxing 1.5–2 hour cruise watching dolphins play in their natural habitat. These boats feature a snack bar, restrooms, and an air-conditioned and heated cabin. Explore the intercoastal waterway where dolphins are plentiful and see marine wildlife up close — a perfect activity for the whole family.

business_name: Beachside Circle Boat Rentals and Sales
about_text: Experience the beauty of the water with Beachside Circle Boats, your go-to destination for easy, fun and unforgettable boat rentals. Whether you're looking to relax, explore the waterways, or spend quality time with family and friends, our boats are designed for comfort and simplicity. No license required, easy and fun to drive. Just show up and enjoy the ride!
hero_text: Fun And Unique Way To Get On The Water
hero_subtext: Rent a portable, eco-friendly circle boat. No license needed, no experience required. Just show up and cruise.
